The Mayo TV icon on your TV’s home screen. The launcher may take a moment to show the change.
Stage draws Mayo TV’s own soft colors. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Mayo TV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent color. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colors.
Looks on GitHub for a newer Mayo TV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favorites and settings stay as they are.

Dark is what Mayo TV is designed for. System follows the TV’s own setting where it has one; Light suits a bright room.
Looks for a new version each time Mayo TV starts and tells you when there is one. Nothing is installed without asking.
Scan the QR code or open the link to choose any available language and contribute across all six Mayo TV translation components.

Help translate Mayo TV into your language
Use %1$s in Mayo TV, whatever language the TV is set to.
Mayo TV follows the language of the TV (now %1$s). Pick one below to use it in Mayo TV only.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, Mayo TV stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and Mayo TV will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using Mayo TV. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.
Mayo TV Worker · no setup
Leave both blank for Mayo TV’s shared Worker. A custom Worker URL takes priority over a direct API key. Account sessions remain profile-specific.
Send all Mayo TV traffic and playback through an HTTP proxy.
This device does not allow Mayo TV to set exact alarms, so a recording may begin a few minutes late. Recordings start earlier to make up for it.

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your Mayo TV backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
Mayo TV could not work out how many channels this provider allows.

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so Mayo TV finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, Mayo TV still falls back to stereo and tells you.
Mayo TV is a player \u2014 bring your own Xtream, M3U, or Stalker source.
Mayo TV is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.
